info.name: Ouroboros A2A Protocol
info.description:
Google Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol endpoints for Ouroboros Desktop.

A2A server runs on port 18800 by default.
All JSON-RPC methods use POST to the root URL.

Protocol version: 0.3.0
SDK: a2a-sdk (Python)

request.description:
Fetch the agent's A2A Agent Card.

Returns: name, description, version, skills, capabilities, supported input/output modes.

The Agent Card is built dynamically from:
- Agent name/description from identity.md or settings
- Skills from ToolRegistry
- Version from ouroboros.get_version()

response.name: Success

request.description:
Send a new message to the agent. Creates a new task.

The agent will:
1. Create a task with status 'working'
2. Dispatch the message to the Ouroboros supervisor
3. Return the completed task with artifacts containing the response

For long-running tasks, the response may return status 'working' — use tasks/get to poll.

Continue an existing task by sending a follow-up message.

Replace REPLACE_WITH_TASK_ID and REPLACE_WITH_CONTEXT_ID with values from the previous response.

Useful when the task returned status 'input-required'.

Send a message with SSE streaming response.

Returns a stream of Server-Sent Events (SSE):
- TaskStatusUpdateEvent (state transitions: working -> completed)
- TaskArtifactUpdateEvent (partial/full results)

Each SSE 'data:' line contains a complete JSON-RPC response.

Note: Postman shows SSE as raw text. Use curl or a dedicated SSE client for real-time streaming.

Get the current state of a task by ID.

Returns the full Task object with status, history, and artifacts.

Task states:
- submitted: created, not yet processing
- working: actively being processed
- input-required: agent needs more info
- completed: done (terminal)
- failed: error (terminal)
- canceled: canceled by client (terminal)
- rejected: refused by agent (terminal)

Get task with message history included.

historyLength controls how many recent messages to return in the history array.

Cancel a running task.

Only works for tasks in non-terminal states (submitted, working, input-required).

Returns error -32002 if the task is already in a terminal state.

Reconnect to an existing task's SSE stream.

Use this to resume streaming after a connection drop.
Returns SSE events for the task's remaining lifecycle.

Reference: A2A-specific JSON-RPC error codes.

| Code | Name | Meaning |
|------|------|--------|
| -32001 | TaskNotFoundError | Task ID unknown |
| -32002 | TaskNotCancelableError | Task in a terminal state |
| -32003 | PushNotificationNotSupported | Agent doesn't support push |
| -32004 | UnsupportedOperationError | Method not implemented |
| -32005 | ContentTypeNotSupported | Input MIME type not accepted |
| -32006 | InvalidAgentResponseError | Agent produced invalid response |

Standard JSON-RPC errors (-32700 parse, -32600 invalid request, -32601 method not found, -32602 invalid params, -32603 internal) also apply.
